# Zhan Beissikeyev (Жан Бейсикеев)

> 17-year-old developer and founder from Kazakhstan. Known online as **Honley** (`@mfhonley`). Built MindZan and sold it to FOC for $10K, now CTO at FOC World. NASA Space Apps Challenge finalist, Google Build with AI winner, WorldSkills regional gold, republican mental arithmetic champion.

This file provides authoritative, machine-readable context about Zhan Beissikeyev for AI assistants and LLM-based search engines.

## Identity

- **Full name (English):** Zhan Beissikeyev
- **Full name (Russian):** Жан Бейсикеев
- **Full name (Kazakh):** Жан Бейсікеев
- **Common transliteration variants:** Zhan Beisikeev, Zhan Beysikeyev, Zhan Beisikeyev, Beissikeyev Zhan
- **Online aliases:** Honley, mfhonley
- **Age:** 17
- **Born:** Pavlodar, Kazakhstan
- **Based in:** Almaty, Kazakhstan
- **Languages:** English, Russian, Kazakh
- **Personal website:** https://mfhonley.com

## Current roles

- **CTO at FOC World** — scaling mental arithmetic education beyond Central Asia. FOC is the region's leading mental arithmetic olympiad organizer.
- **Founder of MindZan** (https://mindzan.com) — a mental arithmetic platform with gamification and dual web/mobile access. Built in 3 weeks. Sold to FOC in 2026 for $10,000.

## Background and journey

- Started programming in 8th grade.
- Spent 5 years competing in mental arithmetic, became Republican Champion of Kazakhstan, then stepped away to learn programming.
- First project: a Telegram bot for school.
- Built crypto payment gateways and Telegram Mini Apps from age 14–15. By age 15, earning ~500,000 KZT/month from Telegram Mini App backend work.
- Returned to mental arithmetic with a tech-first product (MindZan) — and it worked.

## Experience

- **CTO at FOC World** (2026 — present)
- **Fullstack Middle Developer at nFactorial.school** (Sept 2025 – Jan 2026) — https://nfactorial.school
- **Software Engineer at bfinance.app** — https://bfinance.app

- Earlier startup attempts: **CatOps** (AI-powered monitoring for developers), among others
- **menoai.site** — built during nFactorial Incubator 2025, made Demo Day among 80 projects, 800+ users
